 Tulsa nonprofit offers help with Medicare open enrollment
 Life Senior Services offers free Medicare plan reviews and appointments for people who need help comparing their options.
 Kim Jackson 
 November 17, 2026 01:35 PM 1 min read 
 Copy 
 Link copied 
 Email
 Print
 Life Senior Services assists in Medicare open enrollment
 TULSA, Okla. - Medicare open enrollment is nearing its Dec. 7 deadline, but there is still time for beneficiaries to review their coverage and select a plan for the coming year.
 Kathy Jones with Life Senior Services says the process can be stressful because people may not know what changes to expect or where to find reliable help. The organization offers free assistance to anyone with Medicare.
 Why Medicare beneficiaries should review their plans
 Medicare plans can change from year to year, including monthly premiums, covered prescription medications, out-of-pocket costs and other expenses.
 Jones says beneficiaries should review their options even if they are satisfied with their current coverage.
 “Even if you love what you have, you need to look,” Jones said.
 She says people may decide to keep their current plan, but reviewing the options can help them understand what coverage best fits their needs and budget.
 How Life Senior Services can help
 Life Senior Services offers one-on-one appointments at its office, as well as locations in Owasso and Broken Arrow.
 People who cannot leave home can also schedule phone appointments. Medicare specialists can review available plans and help beneficiaries compare their options.
 The assistance is free and is available to anyone who has Medicare. Jones said eligibility is not based on income.
 How to get help before the deadline
 Medicare beneficiaries have until Dec. 7 to make changes during the open enrollment period.
 People can call Life Senior Services at 918-664-9000 and select option five to speak with a Medicare specialist.
 Appointments are required.
